narrative:
The user started on Carvana’s home page, then clicked an image tile in the home brand/category grid to enter the used SUV inventory. On the SUVs page, they expanded several filter accordions, focusing on Fuel Types and MPG, and specifically clicked the Electric fuel type label and checkbox to narrow results to electric SUVs. They then interacted with the on-page search box, typing the query 'audi' (via incremental keystrokes) to refine the SUV results further, and later repeated similar search typing on the more general /cars inventory page.

After using the search, the user shifted to structured filters. In the Make & Model facet, they expanded the section, clicked the label for 'Audi', and toggled the Audi make checkbox. Within the Audi models list, they selected the Q8 model by clicking its label and associated checkbox. Next, they opened the Exterior Colors facet, chose 'Gray Exterior' via its label and checkbox, and then opened the Drive Types facet to select 'AWD' by clicking its label and checkbox. These actions progressively constrained the results to Audi Q8 SUVs with gray exterior and AWD drivetrain. They also interacted with a sticky header button in the filters area—likely a control such as 'Save search', 'Show X results', or 'Clear filters'—although the exact label is not visible from the event data.

From the filtered results, the user clicked within a specific vehicle tile to open that car’s detail page at /vehicle/4195259. On the vehicle page, they used the desktop navigation button (probably 'Back to search' or similar) and a link-style button in the Features & Highlights section, which opened a modal dialog; they then closed this modal via its close (X) icon. Subsequently, they clicked the header logo or main navigation link to return to the broader used cars inventory at /cars.

Back on the cars page, the user continued exploring filters, expanding sections like Seating Capacity and Ways to Save. In Ways to Save, they clicked the label and checkbox for 'Free Delivery', adding this as another constraint on the vehicles they were viewing. Throughout the session, multiple mouseover and focus events occurred on navigation, tiles, and filter controls, but the key actions involved typing 'audi' into search fields, selecting Audi as a make, Q8 as a model, Gray Exterior and AWD as attributes, toggling Electric fuel type and Free Delivery options, and opening and inspecting at least one matching vehicle’s details before returning to browse more cars.
